value.rationale: The motivating primary paper explicitly requests the successful-run conditional-time distribution, which differs drastically from ordinary coupon-collector waiting times. A fixed-fragility success event is exponentially rare and produces a non-Gumbel Boltzmann partition count. The exact first-order TV coefficient and signed perturbation quantify conditional-time approximation sharply and permit exact finite-n error analysis; it is not a routine restatement of an existing success-probability product.
